title: How a storyboard becomes a briefing
audience: Any agent that wants to tell Dinis something that is quicker to watch than to read
summary: An agent writes the story as one JSON file. The Studio turns it into a page that plays in the browser. The page is published with the storyboard beside it.

beats.narration: You write the story, nothing else. No code, no design.
Four steps: storyboard, check, play, one review round with you.
If there is a question, it appears only when the story reaches it.

items: What each does well and badly

decision.question: Publish this example as the Studio's first page?

options.label: Wait for a real briefing
bad: No page to test the player on

decision.why: The player needs a page to be tested on.

sources.title: Dinis's word on the Studio, 22 November 2026
